en.headline: Consultants and contractors may join building repair lists from today
en.dek: The Development Bureau opened a four-week application window for three pre-qualification lists that will govern future large-scale maintenance tenders.
body: The Development Bureau began accepting applications on Wednesday for three pre-qualification lists covering building inspection consultants, supervision consultants who draft tender documents and oversee works, and contractors who carry out the works.

The lists sit under a new building maintenance support service announced last week. Applications run for four weeks until 27 October through an Urban Renewal Authority electronic platform. The bureau said it aims to have the lists ready by the end of the year and to start tendering for owners in the first quarter of next year. Only firms on the lists will be able to bid for jobs let through the new service.

Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn said the bureau and the URA would process applications with other departments and would meet professional institutes and trade associations to explain the criteria and forms. Assessment covers technical capability, integrity, financial strength and past performance. The lists will be reviewed every two years, with provision to suspend or remove firms.

The bureau said the three roles were split to strengthen checks and reduce conflicts of interest after years of disputes over large-scale building repairs. Enquiries are being handled through the URA.

zh.headline: 樓宇維修三張預審名單今起接受申請
zh.dek: 發展局星期三起就驗樓顧問、監督顧問及承建商三張預審名單接受申請，為期四星期至十月二十七日。
body: 發展局星期三起接受申請，編製樓宇維修支援服務下的三張預審名單，分別涵蓋驗樓顧問、負責草擬標書及監督工程的監督顧問，以及負責施工的承建商。
申請期四星期，至十月二十七日截止，經市區重建局電子平台遞交。局方目標今年年底陸續備妥名單，明年首季開始為業主招標。日後只有名單上的公司，才能競投經新支援服務招標的工程。
發展局局長寧漢豪表示，發展局會聯同市建局及相關部門全速處理申請，並約見專業學會和商會講解準則及表格。評審涵蓋技術能力、誠信操守、財務能力及過往表現，名單兩年一檢，其間可暫停或除名。
局方指將驗樓、監督與施工分開，以加強制衡、減少利益衝突。查詢由市建局處理。
